related.note: The Cyber Resilience Act regulates products with digital elements; NIS2 regulates the cybersecurity of entities and services. They overlap at the supply-chain and incident-reporting layer but are separate EU acts.
Both are EU internal law. The AI Act contains cybersecurity duties for certain AI systems; NIS2 is the horizontal infrastructure layer.
